title: Mixing: Smile Away, Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1972
content:
Island Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney

Mixes of two Thrillington songs were made by Paul McCartney on 26 May 1972.

The album, an orchestral version of Paul and Linda McCartney’s 1971 album Ram, had been recorded on 15-17 June 1971.

Although the album had been mixed on 18 June 1971, McCartney was seemingly considering releasing ‘Smile Away’ and ‘Uncle Albert/Admiral Halsey’ as a single, and remixed them on this day.

Perhaps stung by the lukewarm critical and commercial reception to Wings’ second single, ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’, McCartney evidently rethought the plans. Thrillington was shelved for six years, and eventually released in 1977 when it was credited to the pseudonymous Percy ‘Thrills’ Thrillington.

Page last updated: 21 November 2025
